# 会议总结（2026-11-3） {#meeting-1}

## 本周进度

### 内容一：温度与湿度中位数在极差带中的位置

- **温度湿度图像**：<iframe src="middle.html" width="100%" height="620" style="border:1px solid #e0e0e0;"></iframe>
[在新窗口打开交互图](middle.html)

由上图可知，温度的中位数整体偏低，湿度的中位数几乎位于中间

数据用的是这段代码：

```python
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

# =====================================
# 1. 文件路径
# =====================================
humidity_file = r"D:\桌面\一二三期数据\二三期机舱湿度_mean.csv"
temperature_file = r"D:\桌面\一二三期数据\二三期外界温度_mean.csv"

output_file = r"D:\桌面\一二三期数据\85台风机温湿度中位数及极差带.html"

# 风机ID：11～95
fan_ids = [str(i) for i in range(11, 96)]


# =====================================
# 2. 读取CSV
# =====================================
def read_data(path):
    for encoding in ["utf-8-sig", "gbk", "gb18030", "utf-8"]:
        try:
            df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding=encoding)
            print("读取成功：", os.path.basename(path))
            return df
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue

    raise ValueError("无法读取文件，请检查文件编码。")


# =====================================
# 3. 计算每个时刻的统计值
# =====================================
def calculate_statistics(path, variable_name):

    df = read_data(path)

    # 第一列为时间
    time_col = df.columns[0]

    # 统一列名
    df.columns = df.columns.astype(str).str.strip()
    time_col = df.columns[0]

    df[time_col] = pd.to_datetime(
        df[time_col],
        errors="coerce"
    )

    df = df.dropna(subset=[time_col])

    # 选择11～95号风机
    selected_cols = [
        fan for fan in fan_ids
        if fan in df.columns
    ]

    missing_ids = [
        fan for fan in fan_ids
        if fan not in selected_cols
    ]

    print(f"\n{variable_name}实际参与统计的风机数：{len(selected_cols)}")
    print("未找到的风机ID：", missing_ids)

    if len(selected_cols) == 0:
        raise ValueError(f"{variable_name}没有找到目标风机数据。")

    # 数值转换
    data = df[selected_cols].apply(
        pd.to_numeric,
        errors="coerce"
    )

    data.index = df[time_col]

    # 同一时刻有重复记录时，按风机求平均
    data = data.groupby(level=0).mean().sort_index()

    # 逐时刻统计
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=data.index)

    result["中位数"] = data.median(axis=1)
    result["最大值"] = data.max(axis=1)
    result["最小值"] = data.min(axis=1)
    result["有效风机数量"] = data.count(axis=1)

    result["极差"] = (
        result["最大值"] - result["最小值"]
    )

    result = result.reset_index()
    result.rename(
        columns={result.columns[0]: "时间"},
        inplace=True
    )

    return result


# =====================================
# 4. 分别计算温度和湿度
# =====================================
temperature = calculate_statistics(
    temperature_file,
    "外界温度"
)

humidity = calculate_statistics(
    humidity_file,
    "机舱湿度"
)


# =====================================
# 5. 创建上下排列的图表
# =====================================
fig = make_subplots(
    rows=2,
    cols=1,
    shared_xaxes=True,
    vertical_spacing=0.13,
    subplot_titles=[
        "85台风机外界温度中位数及极差带",
        "85台风机机舱湿度中位数及极差带"
    ]
)


# =====================================
# 6. 温度极差带
# =====================================
# 只保留最大值、最小值和时间都有效的记录
temp_valid = temperature.dropna(
    subset=["时间", "最大值", "最小值"]
).copy()

# 保证最大值始终不小于最小值
temp_upper = np.maximum(
    temp_valid["最大值"].to_numpy(),
    temp_valid["最小值"].to_numpy()
)

temp_lower = np.minimum(
    temp_valid["最大值"].to_numpy(),
    temp_valid["最小值"].to_numpy()
)

# 用一个闭合多边形绘制最大值与最小值之间的区域
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=list(temp_valid["时间"]) + list(temp_valid["时间"][::-1]),
        y=list(temp_upper) + list(temp_lower[::-1]),
        fill="toself",
        fillcolor="rgba(66, 165, 245, 0.25)",
        mode="lines",
        line=dict(width=0),
        name="温度极差带（最大值—最小值）",
        hoverinfo="skip"
    ),
    row=1,
    col=1
)

# 温度中位数曲线
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=temperature["时间"],
        y=temperature["中位数"],
        mode="lines",
        line=dict(
            color="#D62728",
            width=1.5
        ),
        name="外界温度中位数",
        customdata=temperature[["有效风机数量"]],
        hovertemplate=(
            "时间：%{x|%Y-%m-%d %H:%M}<br>"
            "温度中位数：%{y:.2f} ℃<br>"
            "有效风机数量：%{customdata[0]} 台"
            "<extra></extra>"
        )
    ),
    row=1,
    col=1
)


# =====================================
# 7. 湿度极差带
# =====================================
humidity_valid = humidity.dropna(
    subset=["时间", "最大值", "最小值"]
).copy()

humidity_upper = np.maximum(
    humidity_valid["最大值"].to_numpy(),
    humidity_valid["最小值"].to_numpy()
)

humidity_lower = np.minimum(
    humidity_valid["最大值"].to_numpy(),
    humidity_valid["最小值"].to_numpy()
)

fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=list(humidity_valid["时间"]) + list(humidity_valid["时间"][::-1]),
        y=list(humidity_upper) + list(humidity_lower[::-1]),
        fill="toself",
        fillcolor="rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.25)",
        mode="lines",
        line=dict(width=0),
        name="湿度极差带（最大值—最小值）",
        hoverinfo="skip"
    ),
    row=2,
    col=1
)

# 湿度中位数曲线
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=humidity["时间"],
        y=humidity["中位数"],
        mode="lines",
        line=dict(
            color="#E67E22",
            width=1.5
        ),
        name="机舱湿度中位数",
        customdata=humidity[["有效风机数量"]],
        hovertemplate=(
            "时间：%{x|%Y-%m-%d %H:%M}<br>"
            "湿度中位数：%{y:.2f}<br>"
            "有效风机数量：%{customdata[0]} 台"
            "<extra></extra>"
        )
    ),
    row=2,
    col=1
)


# =====================================
# 8. 图表格式
# =====================================
fig.update_layout(
    title=dict(
        text="二、三期85台风机温湿度中位数及极差带",
        x=0.5,
        xanchor="center",
        font=dict(size=22)
    ),

    height=1200,

    template="plotly_white",

    hovermode="x",

    dragmode="pan",

    font=dict(
        family="Microsoft YaHei, SimHei, Arial, sans-serif",
        size=13
    ),

    legend=dict(
        orientation="h",
        yanchor="bottom",
        y=1.03,
        xanchor="center",
        x=0.5
    ),

    margin=dict(
        l=80,
        r=50,
        t=150,
        b=110
    )
)


# =====================================
# 9. 坐标轴
# =====================================
fig.update_yaxes(
    title_text="外界温度（℃）",
    row=1,
    col=1,
    showgrid=True,
    zeroline=False
)

fig.update_yaxes(
    title_text="机舱湿度",
    row=2,
    col=1,
    showgrid=True,
    zeroline=False
)

fig.update_xaxes(
    title_text="日期",
    row=2,
    col=1,
    rangeslider=dict(
        visible=True,
        thickness=0.07
    ),
    rangeselector=dict(
        buttons=[
            dict(
                count=1,
                label="1个月",
                step="month",
                stepmode="backward"
            ),
            dict(
                count=3,
                label="3个月",
                step="month",
                stepmode="backward"
            ),
            dict(
                count=6,
                label="6个月",
                step="month",
                stepmode="backward"
            ),
            dict(
                count=1,
                label="1年",
                step="year",
                stepmode="backward"
            ),
            dict(
                step="all",
                label="全部"
            )
        ]
    )
)

fig.update_xaxes(
    showgrid=True,
    row=1,
    col=1
)


# =====================================
# 10. 导出HTML
# =====================================
fig.write_html(
    output_file,
    include_plotlyjs=True,
    full_html=True,
    config={
        "scrollZoom": True,
        "displaylogo": False,
        "responsive": True,
        "modeBarButtonsToRemove": [
            "lasso2d",
            "select2d"
        ]
    }
)

# 同时保存统计数据
temperature.to_csv(
    r"D:\桌面\一二三期数据\85台风机逐时刻温度统计.csv",
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

humidity.to_csv(
    r"D:\桌面\一二三期数据\85台风机逐时刻湿度统计.csv",
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

print("\n全部处理完成！")
print("HTML文件：", output_file)
print("温度和湿度统计CSV也已保存。")
```
